entries.title: NEW badge tuned to real additions
items: The badge now starts from the catalog's new_badge_since baseline, so the initial bulk seeding is not flagged as new.
Only entries added on or after 2026-10-14, within the last 5 days, carry NEW.

entries.title: NEW badges for freshly added repos
items: Every catalog entry now records the date it was added.
The site marks entries from the last 5 days with a NEW badge and a New filter, computed in the visitor's browser so they expire on their own.

entries.title: KernelSU module source, and a renamed relay repo
items: Added compdoge/gxr-ksu-modules to KernelSU Modules: a module source the GXR manager browses under Sources.
compdoge/gxr-alvr-ft follows its rename to compdoge/gxr-root-ft, with its release badge brought up to date.

entries.title: Aurora Store and a changelog tab
items: Added whyorean/AuroraStore to Tools & Diagnostics.
The site gained a Changelog tab, rendered from this file like everything else; CHANGELOG.md mirrors it for GitHub.

entries.title: Obtainium and the emulation pack
items: Added ImranR98/Obtainium to Tools & Diagnostics.
Added RJNY/Obtainium-Emulation-Pack to Games & Emulation.

entries.title: VectorXR
items: Added DienerTech/vectorxr to PC VR & Streaming.

entries.title: PimaxMagic4All, PCVR Mods Hub and Moonlight XR
items: Added mbucchia/PimaxMagic4All, Mr-Nlce/PCVR-Mods-Installer-Hub and Gilleece/moonlight-android-xr to PC VR & Streaming.
Widened that group's blurb to cover PC-side VR tooling.

entries.title: ALVR USB badge and pyrowave note
items: Terminal-ennui/Galaxy_XR_ALVR_USB gained its v0.2.0-beta release badge and a sharper line.
Terminal-ennui/pyrowave is now marked as the codec fork behind the ALVR 4:4:4 builds.

entries.title: Game Link and QuestLHSync entries enriched
items: 4uva4ek/galaxy-xr-game-link line corrected after reading its README.
stearnsbq/questlhsync-galaxy-xr gained its v0.4.1 release badge and a PC-side requirement note.

entries.title: diabl0w/KernelSU moved to Foundations
items: Moved diabl0w/KernelSU out of Root & Kernel: it is the source base both root stacks build on, not an XR deliverable.

entries.title: 20 more repos and a new Apps & Samples group
items: Added 20 community repos found by a GitHub sweep: Lighthouse sync modules, ALVR streaming variants, face-tracking relays, lens QR tools and more.
New Apps & Samples group for players, samples and small apps.

entries.title: Catalog opens with 25 repos
items: Added the first 25 repos across 8 groups: root and kernel tooling, KernelSU modules, PC VR drivers, app patches, emulation and diagnostics.
README, Pages site and agent docs published, all generated from catalog.json.
